patterns.note: Full-width sections with large, aspirational photography are used extensively for hero areas and feature blocks, often with text overlays for calls to action.
A strong, clean sans-serif typeface is used for all headings and body text, with some uppercase styling for labels and calls to action, providing clear hierarchy and readability.
A deep teal/forest green is consistently used as the primary brand accent color for navigation, links, and key text elements, contrasting with white and light grey backgrounds.

The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport after an initial promotional top bar scrolls away. Sections appear to reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Product grids are presented with a clean, minimal design, featuring product images, names, prices, and star ratings, often within a horizontal scrollable carousel.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a smooth scrolling library (locomotive-scroll) to enhance the user experience. Sections are revealed with scroll-triggered animations, likely using CSS keyframes, where elements fade in and subtly slide into place as they become visible in the viewport.
A sticky header is implemented where the primary navigation bar fixes to the top of the screen on scroll, while a smaller, promotional top bar disappears.

Large background images are used in hero and feature sections, with text content positioned over them. These images may have a subtle fixed background or parallax effect as the user scrolls, creating depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold sans-serif, ranging from large hero text (~3x body) to clear section titles, with body text and labels in a legible sans-serif.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — airy hero sections and content blocks, with denser but well-padded product grids.

standout: The site's standout feature is its masterful integration of high-quality, aspirational outdoor photography with a clean, functional e-commerce layout. The consistent use of a deep teal brand color and strong sans-serif typography creates a sophisticated yet rugged brand identity that feels authentic to its outdoor lifestyle products.
